C0354.title: Zhejiang Company Ordered to Pay 350,000 Yuan for Credential-Stuffing Data Access
C0354.summary: On October 31, 2019, Hangzhou Internet Court publicly announced its judgment in an unfair-competition dispute brought by Hangzhou Company A and Hangzhou Company B against Zhejiang Company C. The court found that the defendant had used credential stuffing for about six years to log in to Women’s Wear Network member accounts and view distributor data. It ordered the defendant to stop the infringement, pay the two plaintiffs 350,000 yuan in economic losses, and bear civil liability for eliminating the impact.
